notes.title: Stability Patch
notes.notes:
Hello Players!  👋

Thank you for all the feedback we have been receiving since our last update! Today we are bringing you another patch with a fix that mattered to you the most! 🔨

Last patch we acknowledged that there are ongoing crashes and thanks to you constantly sending us details and crashlogs, we managed to make fixes on various reasons  for it happening. 

So this patch is focused entirely on fixing crashes.

This is not the end though! There can be various reasons, and we are aware that all of it may not be fixed, so we asked you kindly to send us more crashlogs, if any occur. With more details of what is happening, so each of you can enjoy Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 in its full glory! 

Everything you send us helps us immensely in improving the game, and we want to thank you for all the dedication you give us. 🔥

How to Send Crash Logs:
1️⃣ Open the Windows Start menu and type %appdata% into the search bar.
2️⃣ Once the folder appears, navigate back from “Roaming” to the AppData directory.
3️⃣ Go to Local/ShipGraveyard2/Saved/Crashes and locate the most recent folder.
4️⃣ Zip all the files inside that folder.
5️⃣ Send the zipped files to us through the #crashlogs-ticket channel on our Discord.

notes.title: Patch 1.5.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just rolled out another patch for Ship Graveyard Simulator 2, focusing on squashing some of the more persistent bugs that many of you have reported. As always, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback — it really helps us improve the game for everyone.


Here’s what’s been fixed in this update:

🔧 Some heavy elements on steam ships could not be lifted – fixed
🔧 Steam ships levitating pieces and props – fixed
🔧 Some props didn’t have collision – fixed
🔧 Yellow connectors placed in weird/unreachable spots – fixed
🔧 After upgrading the house, a collectible from the recent ship was still there, even though it wasn’t collected – fixed


We also want to acknowledge the issues some of you are still experiencing — especially in multiplayer mode. Please know that we’re actively working on improving it. We’re doing everything we can to make the experience smoother and more fun with every update.


Thanks again for your support, patience, and continued passion for Ship Graveyard Simulator 2. You keep us going ❤️

Stay tuned —
Ship Graveyard Team

notes.title: Huge Major Update! 🛳️
notes.notes:
New stuff! We've introduced functionality to add some flair & personality to your scrapyard house. You can now expand it with new rooms, decorate it and paint however you'd like! We've also expanded the beach, adding another big area to run & drive around, prepared for some very big ships... Whenever they arrive. We've also implemented changes to the crate weight limit, so now the highest upgrade level can fit even more stuff!

📌 IMPORTANT
First game launch after patch might take a minute or two along with ~5fps showing, but do not worry - it's the engine generating metafiles for better optimization. After the first launch, every consecutive launch will be much, much much faster. Same with game saves.

DirectX Version
If you are experiencing crashes on the loading screen, please change the DirectX version in Steam's game settings.

New stuff! We've added a functionallity to add some flair & personality to your scraypard house. You can now expand it with new rooms, decorate it and paint however you'd like! We've also expanded the beach, adding another big area to run & drive around, prepared for some very big ships... Once they arrive.


First game launch after patch might take a minute or two along with ~5fps showing, but do not worry - it's the engine generating metafiles for better optimization. After the first launch, every consecutive launch will be much, much much faster. Same with game saves.



Patch notes: 

SINGLEPLAYER: 


 Optimizations, performance boost by up to ~40%
 Much faster game launching time
 Optimized save system & loading system
 Electric hazard not turning off properly has been fixed
 Steam hazard not turning off properly has been fixed
 Hulls not falling down after loading a save & using winch fixed
 Better UI optimization
 Game loosing focus fixed
 Crate auto-snap not working after save load fixed
 Scanner not showing info about props fixed
 Gamepad UI navigation improvements & fixes
 Hammer updgare animation showing when buying bombs fixed
 Keybind changes not saving sometimes fixed
 Grappling hook crosshair not showing fixed


MULTIPLAYER: 


 Ships not spawning properly with all elements fixed
 Spawning submarines kicking guests from server fixed
 Client's truck load gets reset after using "Sort excess" fixed
 Scrapping ship causing clients to get kicked fixed
 Limbo after leaving the server for clients fixed
 Back to main menu not working for clients & host sometimes fixed
 Crate in client's hands having wrong texture & animation fixed
 Buying mobile cargo causes hammer upgrade animation to play fixed
 Mobile cargo not registering crates thrown into it fixed
 Mobile cargo displaying as empty for the client fixed
 Launching many bombs causes client to get disconnected fixed
 Weight from host to client updating fixed
 Added option to block guests from using shops (and spending host's money without permission, anti-troll tool)
 Nicknames over player's heads will be now visible through walls to let players know about their positions
 PIN functionallity fixed
 Connectors visibility for server guests improved & tweaked




How to get to Unstable-Branch? It's simple! 👇

1. You must have Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 in your Steam library
2. Find the game in your Steam library
3. Right-click on it
4. Select "Properties"
5. Then the "Betas" tab
6. Select the "unstable-default" version from the list
7. Enter password: ShipTest1235

Please, remember to report any bugs or issues here on Steam or on our Discord and make sure to do the copy of your saves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/8bbcdd8ce4dded5cdca9d342fcce25a252dcaf7a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/e9c63c6c9fa349b772dc29a62eef50896ce7ff5b.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/05f5a7c868f062af5f8369b53414accb3fdfb221.jpg

If you have any questions, please write to us on Discord or on Community Hub
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/25cdf2608fb8ca229fa863444a8fbfb772c1e50f.png

We hope you enjoy testing out the new patch on the unstable-branch. Let us know your feedback and suggestions to help us refine the update before the official release! Happy scrapping! ⚙️



See you soon,
Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 Team

notes.title: Update on the release date of Playtest CO-OP Mode
notes.notes:
Dear community,

Last week we promised that the Playtest of CO-OP Mode would be available this week, but unfortunately, with great heartache, we have to inform you about the change of the Playtest release date.

Currently, the entire team is involved in bug fixes for Warships DLC, which really surprised us. As a small development team, we want to first improve the stability of the Warships DLC and then fully focus on the Playtest of CO-OP Mode so that you can fully enjoy smashing ships with hammers with your friends, that's why we need a few more days.

Therefore, we decided to change the Playtest release date. We want to be absolutely sure that you - our community - who support our game by purchasing DLC, could enjoy the game without any problems.

Thank you for your understanding - the entire team is working very hard to make sure you can fully experience this next milestone with Ship Graveyard Simulator 2. We assure you that the Playtest version will be ready soon.

We will get back to you with further information - thank you. 🤝
Ship Graveyard Simulator Team

List of news and fixes: 


 New small ship with all new contracts - Slippery Herring
 Crane upgrades - players are able to purchase crane upgrades to speed it up
 Crane queue - players are able to choose more than one heavy element and queue them
 Crouching - new player ability to crouch. Please note that those who own the game and use their own settings must choose the crouching input manually in the settings.
 New wiki entries
 Mobile cargo - mobile cargo is handy while picking many crates at the same time and throw them inside. Once full, crane picks them all up and stores in the warehouse.  Collectibles - there're collectibles to find on all the ships. Once the collectible has been found it'll be stored in the house. They're also full of fun facts.
 Celebrations - new "celebrating" animations once the tool upgrade is purchased.
 New achievements
 Winch improvements
 "Lord of the tools" achievement fix
 Improvements for picking up and attempt to fix the picking problems
 Auto snap improvements
 UI improvements
 Tutorial fixes
 Auto save fixes
 Ship fixes
 Texts fixes
 Gameplay optimisation
 Other minor bugfixes

At the very beginning, we would like to thank each of you for your feedback, Steam opinions, and ideas that you write to us - thank you for your commitment after the premiere, it is invaluable to us. 🤝

💡 We are constantly writing down all your suggestions, and the bugs you have found and the whole team is working to fix them. Today we come to you with the first patch, and you can expect more fixes and optimizations in the coming week.

FULL LIST OF CHANGES IN PATCH 1.0.1

 Fixed the issue with rope blocking itself, which forced players to reload the game.
 Added an option to start sorting minigame while having materials in a warehouse but nothing on the truck.
 Saw sounds were adjusted.
 Fixed missing symbols in Chinese localization.
 Fixed the issue which didn't allow players to buy upgrades while having the exact amount of needed materials.
 Fixed model of first level hammer.
 Corrected asset of the lamp which players could find on the ships.
 Enabling Wiki has been disabled while players had a tutorial popup visible.
 Fixed the amount of resources on Snopkovich and ChillingTurtle in ShipTube.
 Disabled the possibility of riding on the hulls of ChillingTurtle to get out of the map.
 Fixed anntens connectors.
 Fixed issue with falling down parts on GreenRex.
 Fixed texts and translations in the game.
We are currently working on fixing another bugs which include:
 Crashes of the game.
 Tools being blocked.
 Issue with never ending night after loading the game.
 Issue with crane being busy after loading the game.
